name: Reading List Librarian
description: Answers questions about a set of research papers: which cite which, how they are filed, who wrote them and what a verification pass said of them.
system_prompt: Answer from the papers graph only. Return rows; do not summarise papers you have not been given.

tools.name: Who Cites This Paper
tools.description: Lists the papers in the set that cite one named paper.

config.template: MATCH (cited:Paper)<-[:CITES]-(citing:Paper) WHERE cited.title = $paperTitle RETURN citing.arxiv AS arxiv, citing.title AS citingPaper ORDER BY arxiv LIMIT $limit

parameters.name: paperTitle
parameters.description: The title of the paper that is cited, or a distinctive part of it.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of papers to return.

tools.name: What This Paper Cites
tools.description: Lists the papers in the set that one named paper cites in its own text.

config.template: MATCH (source:Paper)-[:CITES]->(cited:Paper) WHERE source.title = $sourceTitle RETURN cited.arxiv AS arxiv, cited.title AS citedPaper ORDER BY arxiv LIMIT $limit

parameters.name: sourceTitle
parameters.description: The title of the paper doing the citing, or a distinctive part of it.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of papers to return.

tools.name: Most Cited Papers
tools.description: Ranks all papers by how many other papers in the set cite them. Takes no paper name.

config.template: MATCH (cited:Paper)<-[:CITES]-(citing:Paper) RETURN cited.arxiv AS arxiv, cited.title AS paper, count(citing) AS citedBy ORDER BY citedBy DESC, arxiv LIMIT $limit

tools.name: Papers Filed Under a Category
tools.description: Lists the papers filed under one category code, such as SKE, ROU, INS or SKS.

config.template: MATCH (category:Category)<-[:IN]-(paper:Paper) WHERE category.name = $categoryCode RETURN paper.arxiv AS arxiv, paper.title AS paper, paper.verdict AS verdict ORDER BY arxiv LIMIT $limit

parameters.name: categoryCode
parameters.description: The category's short code, two or three capital letters.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of papers to return.

tools.name: Papers by an Author
tools.description: Lists the papers one named person wrote.

config.template: MATCH (author:Author)-[:WROTE]->(paper:Paper) WHERE author.name = $authorName RETURN paper.arxiv AS arxiv, paper.title AS paper, paper.year AS year ORDER BY arxiv LIMIT $limit

parameters.name: authorName
parameters.description: The author's name, or their family name.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of papers to return.

tools.name: Papers With a Verification Verdict
tools.description: Lists the papers whose summary a verification pass marked with one verdict: correct, corrected or needs-citation.

config.template: MATCH (paper:Paper) WHERE paper.verdict = $verdict OPTIONAL MATCH (paper)-[:IN]->(category:Category) RETURN paper.arxiv AS arxiv, category.name AS category, paper.title AS paper ORDER BY category, arxiv LIMIT $limit

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of papers to return.
